findings: Amendment reviewed 2026-10-28: the new decision reasoning scenario requires report.json to carry the work order risk hints and a decision object whose approver entry lists the reviews counted in the run, the reviewer stations the pipeline expected, and one plain sentence naming the aggregation branch that produced the verdict, and whose human gate entry records whether a human is required, the risk hints that matched, and one plain sentence naming the gate branch taken. anvil/approver.py generates the verdict and the human gate outcome together with their sentences from the same values the code acts on (aggregate_explained and needs_human_explained are the single code paths behind aggregate and needs_human), the runner stores them at the approver step and at the end of the run, and the same two sentences are repeated in swimlane.md under a Decision heading. Reports written before this change carry no decision object and their files are not rewritten.
